text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab Baath Socialist Party holds special session
- The party adds two more members to its regional command
- Italian workers send a present to President Saddam Hussein
- Iraq reviews with U.N. ways of implementing oil-for-food deal
- Ministry of information holds festival on the 1st anniversary of the referendum which reinstated Saddam as president for seven more years
- Russia urges rival Kurds to start dialogue
- Iran's exile group, the Mujahideen, says Tehran planning a security cordon in northern Iraq
- Aziz receives German member of parliament
- U.S. overlooks Iran's meddling in Kurdish affairs
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
